description: Deep reflection prompts for meaningful self-exploration
usage: Show in prompt library, daily prompt rotation, guided reflection flow

prompts.text: What would you do differently at work if you knew no one was watching?
What's the gap between how you present yourself professionally and who you actually are?
What would you need to believe about yourself to ask for what you deserve?
What's a professional risk you've been avoiding — and what's really holding you back?
If your career is a story, what chapter are you in right now?
What parts of your work feel like you? What parts feel like performance?
What would 'enough' look like in your career?
What are you pretending is fine about your job that isn't?
If money weren't a factor, how would your relationship with work change?
What's a boundary you've been meaning to set at work?
Where in your work are you performing someone else's version of success?
What would your younger self think of your career choices?
What's the hardest part about your job that you don't talk about?
What do you need from the people in your life that you're afraid to ask for?
Who do you become around certain people, and why?
What conversation have you been avoiding, and what makes it hard to have?
What's the difference between how you want to be loved and how you are loved?
What's a relationship pattern you keep repeating?
What would change if you stopped trying to be understood and focused on understanding?
What do you give in relationships that you wish you'd receive?
What's something you've never told someone close to you?
Who do you miss, and what do you miss about them?
What relationship needs more attention right now?
What's a boundary you need to set with someone you love?
When do you feel most seen by the people in your life?
What's something you wish you could say to someone who's no longer in your life?

categories.name: Identity & Self
categories.description: Who you are and who you're becoming

prompts.text: What part of yourself are you still trying to prove?
What would you do if you stopped comparing yourself to others?
What's a belief about yourself that's no longer serving you?
What's something you know to be true about yourself that others might not see?
What permission do you keep almost giving yourself?
What are you outgrowing?
What would change if you treated yourself the way you treat people you love?
What's a part of yourself you've hidden for too long?
What would you do if you knew you couldn't fail — and what does that tell you?
What's the story you've been telling yourself that might not be true?
What are you most proud of that no one else knows about?
What would feel different if you fully accepted yourself as you are today?
What's a version of yourself you're afraid to let go of?
What does 'enough' mean to you?
What's something you value that you don't make time for?
What would your life look like if you lived by your values more consistently?
What's worth sacrificing for?
What would you want your life to mean?
What's something you believe that goes against what others expect of you?
What does a good day look like — really?
What have you learned about yourself in the past year?
What would you regret not doing?
What's a value you compromise on more than you'd like to?
What do you want to be remembered for?
What's worth being uncomfortable for?
What brings you peace?

categories.name: Fear & Vulnerability
categories.description: What scares you and what it means

prompts.text: What's a fear that's running your life more than you'd like to admit?
What would you do if fear weren't a factor?
What are you protecting yourself from — and is it working?
What's the worst thing that could happen if you were fully honest?
What's a vulnerability you've turned into strength?
What would you attempt if you knew you could recover from failure?
What's the fear beneath your fear?
What are you afraid to want?
What would feel different if you stopped protecting yourself?
What's a risk you're glad you took?
What's keeping you from asking for help?
What would you do if you weren't afraid of judgment?
What's a fear you've been carrying since childhood?
What change are you resisting?
What needs to end so something else can begin?
What's a pattern you want to break?
What would your future self thank you for doing today?
What's something you've been putting off that would change your life?
What's a difficult lesson you're currently learning?
What are you becoming?
What would you need to let go of to move forward?
What's the next version of yourself asking you to do?
What's a small change that could have a big impact?
What would it look like to outgrow this chapter?
What habit is no longer serving you?
What's a belief you need to update?
